summary: Added 2 global long-video topics (inflation, 1.4-5.4M references; how big a billion is, 7-12M references), bringing the feed to 7. Studied charts: our last two long videos barely draw money over time, so I routed 4 adopts (one a trillion-formatting bug) and 2 new chart/scene templates.
why: L-20261023-01 had 2 chart beats in 136 and L-20261026-01 none in 121, while the long explainers people watch spend their best moments on a number moving. Money-at-scale (jack pockets 12.3M, RealLifeLore 9.5M, Tom Scott 8.3M) and inflation (5.4M, 2.5M, 1.55M) are proven long shapes we haven't told.
